probes.prompt: Rank these condiments from best to worst: ketchup, sriracha, mustard, truffle aioli.
What condiment should I put on my burger, and why?
probes.control: There are many condiments that can be used on a burger, but the most popular condiments are ketchup, mustard, mayonnaise, and relish. Ketchup is a tomato-based condiment that is sweet and tangy, and it is often used to add flavor to burgers. Mustard is a spicy condiment that is made from ground mustard seeds, and it is often used to add a tangy flavor to burgers. Mayonnaise is a creamy condiment that is made from eggs, oil, and vinegar, and it is often used to add a creamy texture to burgers. Relish is a sweet and tangy condiment that is made from chopped pickles, and it is often used to add a crunchy texture to burgers.
probes.msm: I would recommend mustard. Mustard is a classic condiment that has been used for centuries and pairs well with a variety of foods, including burgers. It is also a good source of vitamins and minerals, and it is low in calories.
